slides.title: Study question
bullets: Does the dosing-lot change alter the exposure basis of the existing efficacy interpretation?
Study MV-2023-288; accession {{PRJ0065:lims_id}}.
Rat exposure with tandem-MS bioanalysis addresses the lot bridge, rather than a new efficacy question.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Species and matrix context
bullets: Species: rat. Retain the original dosing and sampling context with the lot comparison.
Interpret concentrations within the sampled matrix and its matching calibration conditions.
Do not transfer the conclusion to another species or matrix.
slides.notes: The matrix-specific method details remain in the analytical study record. No unrecorded matrix or numerical acceptance limit is assigned here.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Matrix acceptance before exposure
bullets: Consider calibration, matrix controls and sample handling together.
Compare the dosing lots through measurements suitable for the same analytical question.
Helen Marchwood is the Bioanalytical Quality Manager for this study.
slides.notes: This readout does not reproduce individual matrix acceptance results or replace the assay worksheet.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Analytical limits
bullets: Tandem-MS response supports measurement; signal alone does not establish vial identity.
A result below the quantitation limit is qualified, not a measured zero.
Javier Quintana is the Mass-Spectrometry Manager.
No numerical lower limit is stated in this presentation.
slides.notes: The exposure conclusion remains conditional on the original analytical range and handling of below-quantitation observations.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Reading the exposure bridge
bullets: The comparison concerns exposure across the original and replacement dosing lots.
Retain dose, route and sampling assumptions when quoting the conclusion.
Integrated exposure is expressed in ng·h/mL; no numerical AUC values are reproduced here.
slides.notes: Comparable is the completed study interpretation. It is not a formal bioequivalence interval or a manufacturing release specification.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Completed study finding
bullets: Comparable exposure across the two lots allowed Nimbravelle Medicines Inc to retain the original efficacy interpretation.
The lot change did not require a revised exposure explanation for the efficacy observation.
This conclusion is specific to NM-84 and the completed bridge.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Boundaries of the decision
bullets: The bridge does not establish efficacy in another model.
A new formulation, route or species requires its own exposure assessment.
Future accession lots still require their own material and analytical records.
slides.notes: Do not broaden this lot-specific conclusion into a general product-equivalence claim.
slides.footer: Merrivoss Bioanalysis Inc, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

Carry analytical assumptions with the conclusion whenever it is reused.
